name: Developer
note: The installer (bin/app_install.php, step 'registry') writes mcp/registries/developer.json in the kernel from this file's `resolve` block plus mcp/action_registry.json. Each resolve tool answers a plain LIST of rows carrying id_field and label_field when given `q` alone (docs/developer-mcp-tool-surface.md, 'The resolvers'). A target resolves by its database name; a workbench, a change set, a saved query and a draft by their titles. An object is an address and a run, plan, window, job or item an id — never resolved by name. Only five actions admit an agent (design §5); every other action is people-only, so the resolvers matter for those five and for the command bar's navigation.
